content: Dule isguele, burgoed
Bab-Jehová anga sogded:
“¿Ar ibiga Israel-yargi ibmar-odukuar-sogleged gannar-gannar sogdamala? Weyob sogdamalad:
”Ani an Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikad, na dukin ise-sogar soged: Israel-yargine, we-ibmar-odukuar-soglegedi bipisaale bar gannar soglegosulid.
Ar dule isguele, burgoed. Bela dulemala angadid. Babgan, degi, mimmiganse-bakale, angadid.
”Dule-innikidaedi, igar-inniki-maid-wisid, a-igar-maidba igar-innikigwad-imakele, dula-gudii guoed.

Dule-innikidaedi, bab-dummadyob-ibmar-imakleged-e-nug-odummogega, yar-birgi mas-gundamaladba akadisulile, dula-gudii guoed. Dule-innikidaedi, Israel-e-bab-dummadyob-ibmar-imaklegedse gordisulile, dule-baid-omebo negsichidgi galagwensuli-gudisulile, ome-igar-dakdiidse gordisulile, dula-gudii guoed.

content.text: egi mani-ganikidga gannar ega ormar ukele, dula-gudii guoed.
Dule-innikidaedi, an-igar-uksadba ibmar-imakele, degi, an-igar-mesisadba nanadiile,
Ibmar-atursadibalile, egi mani-ganikidga bar gannar or ukdisulile,
”We-machi-isgana, machi-nikunonimogale, e-machi na e-bab-ibmar-isgana-imaksad bela daksadibe,
egi mani-ganikidga gannar ega or ukele, dula-gudii guoed.
an-igar-mesisadba ibmar-imakele, deginbali, an-igar-uksadba nanadibalile, nuedid.

content: ”Ar e-babdi, sabsur-dule-imakdii gusad, dule-baid-ibe ibmar-atursadii gusad, degi, e-dulemar-abargi ibmar-isgana-imakdii gusad. Degisoggu, e-isgued-ular, burgoed.

”Ar bemardi soged: ‘¿Ar ibiga e-bab-isgued-ular, e-machidi sabsur-odurdaklegosuli?’ Ar machidi dule-nuedid, dule-innikigwadid, ar ade, an-igar-mesisadba ibmar-imaked, degi, eba nanadibalid. Weyob machi-daedi, dula-gudii guoed.

Dule isgusale, burgoed. Ar machi-wargwensaale, e-bab-isgued-ular, sabsur-odurdaklegosulid. Ar deyobmodo, bab-wargwensaale, e-machi-isgued-ular, sabsur-odurdaklegosurmogad. ”Dule-nued na ibmar-nued-imakedba ega ibmar-nuegan uklegoed. Dule-isgana na ibmar-isgana-imakedba ega ibmar-isgana uklegoed.”
Bab-Dummad-Igar, Igar-napiragwadid
Bab-Jehová sogdebalid: “Ar dule-isgana, bela e-isgued-imaksadgi banguele, an-Igar-Mesisadba ibmar-imakele, igar-inniki-maidba igar-saele, degi, igar-innikigwad imakele, burgosulid, dula-gudii guoed.
Bab-Jehová, we-dule-isgana-e-isgusad bar ebinsaosulid. Ar igar-innikigwad-imaked-ular, dula-gudii guoed.
¿Ar ande, dule-isgana-burgwed yeerdak be ebinsae? Suli. Ar bur e-daed-ogwaed an abeged, dulagudigued an abeged. Ani an Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikadi weyob soged.

”Ar dule-nued igar-innikigwad-imakdiidgi aibatele, degi, ibmar-isgana imakdele, dule-isgana-ibmar-imakedba ibmar-imakdemogale, ¿dula-gudii guo be ebinsae? Suli. Na e-nosad-ular, burgoed. E-isgued-ular, burgoed. E-ibmar-nuegan-imaksad bar-ebinsalegosulid.
”Bemar soged: ‘Bab-Jehová, dule-isganaye.’ Emigindi, Israel-dulemar be an-itoge: ¿Ibigi an dule-isgana? ¿Ar bemar bur dule-isganasursi?
Ar dule-nued ibmar-nued-imaked bar imaksulile, ibmar-isgana imakdele, na e-ibmar-isgana-imaked-ular, burgoed.
Ar dule-isgana na e-isgudiidgi aibatele, igar-inniki-maidba igar-imakele, deginbali, igar-innikigwad imakbalile, na san bendakoed.
Na e-isgudiid magar-itononikile, degi, e-ibmar-isgana-imakdiidgi aibatele, burgosulid, ar dula-gudii guoed.
”Degi-inigwele, Israel-dulemar sogdimalad: ‘Bab-Jehová, dule-isganaye.’ Israel-dulemar, ¿ibigi an dule-isgana? ¿Ar bemar bur dule-isganasursi?

”Degisoggu, Israel-dulemar, war-wargwengi be-daedba an bega igar nabogoed. Ani Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikadi weyob soged. ”Degisoggu, mer isguedse be bergumalaga, be-isguedga be bukib-binsamar, be-ibmar-isgana-imakdiid be iemar.
Israel-dulemar, bela ibmar-isganamar isguega-be-imaksamaladi be mimar. Gwage-binid, burba-binid-nikued be amimar. ¿Ar ibiga isgued-ular, be burgwebimarsunna?
Ar dule-wargwensaale burgwed an abesulid. Be-daed be ogwamar, dula-gudii be gumaloed. Ani an Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikadi weyob soged.”
